story.summary: Build agent dashboard queue for pending low-confidence items, showing query preview, bot name, confidence %, and wait time, sorted oldest-first. Real-time updates via WebSocket/SSE, fallback to polling. Multi-tenancy enforced. [Source: 5-1-hitl-queue-view.md]

requirements.requirement: Queue view shows item count badge, sorted list, each item with query preview, bot name, confidence %, time waiting.
Empty state: "No items pending review. Nice work!"

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Queue shows item count badge and sorted list (oldest-first).
Empty state message when queue is empty.

structure.backend: API/handler for queue, WebSocket/SSE, RLS, review_queue schema.
structure.frontend: Dashboard queue view, badge, list, empty state, WebSocket client.
structure.sharedTypes: Queue item DTO in shared package.
